title: What a Mosquito Bite Really Does

sections.name: What a Mosquito Bite Really Does
lines: When a mosquito bites you, it's not just one needle going in.
Only females bite. They need your blood to make their eggs.
Her mouth hides six tiny needles. Two of them saw through your skin.
Another hunts for a blood vessel, while one pumps in spit that stops your blood from clotting.
She can drink up to three times her own weight.
That itchy bump is your immune system, reacting to her spit.
And scratching it? That only makes it itchier.
